verdicts.reason: A: a sensible side-by-side split with the phone layered over the card, but the eyebrow '30-DAY CHALLENGE' has moved below the headline, the card runs off the right and bottom edges, and the headline is cramped against the card's right edge. B: the dark card covers almost the whole canvas, so the brand's colourful pattern shrinks to a thin border. The small phone sits bottom-left and the CTA floats mid-right with large dead space above it. The eyebrow is again below the headline.

Both use the same phone-left, card-right layout with the eyebrow wrongly placed below the headline and microscopic legal text. A insets the card with margins on the top, right and bottom, so it frames better. B's card bleeds off the right and bottom edges and its headline nearly touches the right edge.

A keeps the original's vertical story: pattern on top, phone overlapping the card, centred headline and CTA. But the phone is shrunk, the eyebrow sits below the headline, the left-aligned legal line breaks the centred axis, and the card runs off the bottom edge. B (phone left, card right) adapts to the square better, but the oversized phone competes with the headline, the eyebrow order is wrong, and the card bleeds off the edges.
